What does Salvador really cost in 2026?
• Elevador Lacerda: R$ 1 (about US$ 0.20)
• Acarajé at a famous stand: US$ 3–5
• Barra lighthouse: about US$ 3
• Boat day to the islands: from about US$ 19, plus island fees
4 days from US$ 235 per person, budget style.
